title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: AWS
providers.scope_notes: Covers Amazon Web Services (IAM, STS, IAM Identity Center, IAM Roles Anywhere, Amazon Bedrock). All features are available in every AWS account; SCPs and centralized root access require AWS Organizations, and Control Tower controls require AWS Control Tower.

controls.name: aws:SourceIp deny policy
controls.what: Identity policy or SCP that denies any request from outside listed CIDR ranges.
controls.setting: IAM policy / SCP with NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp

controls.name: aws:TokenIssueTime deny policy
controls.what: Deny policy that blocks temporary credentials issued before a chosen time; does not affect long-term keys.

controls.name: bedrock:CallWithBearerToken deny
controls.what: Denying this action blocks use of Bedrock API keys; bedrock:bearerTokenType targets SHORT_TERM or LONG_TERM.

controls_unknown: Whether long-term Bedrock API keys can be set to never expire, and their maximum lifetime.
Token format/prefix for Bedrock API keys (not documented on fetched pages).
Which CloudTrail field identifies the specific Bedrock API key on a request (key value is not logged).

authentication.summary: Bearer token generated client-side from an existing IAM session (console or token-generator library); inherits that principal's permissions and works only in its Region.

federation.details: Lifetime is capped by the session used to generate it, so it follows whatever federated session produced it.

ip_restriction.boundary: Same IAM policy conditions as the generating principal.

lifetime.summary: Up to 12 h or the generating session, whichever is shorter

renewal.summary: Generate a new token from valid AWS credentials.

administration.summary: Deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken (bearerTokenType SHORT_TERM) to block; contain by invalidating the generating session.

sso.details: The key inherits the generating session, so it is subject to SSO/MFA only when that session was.

offboard.details: The key inherits the expiration of the session that generated it, so it keeps working until that session ends (max 12 hours).

inventory.details: AWS says the Bedrock console does not list short-term keys after they are generated.

disable.ui: IAM policy or SCP: Deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken (and bedrock-mantle:CallWithBearerToken) with condition bedrock:bearerTokenType = SHORT_TERM
disable.cli: aws iam put-user-policy / put-role-policy, or aws organizations attach-policy

sso.ui: Enforce MFA on the generating principal: IAM policy condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent, or IAM Identity Center > Settings > Authentication > Multi-factor authentication

network.ui: Add Deny * / NotIpAddress aws:SourceIp to the generating user or role policy, or an SCP

expiry.ui: Bedrock console > API keys > Short-term API keys > Generate short-term API keys (expires with the console session, max 12 h)

reads.ui: CloudTrail console > Event history > Event name filter = Converse

kill.ui: IAM console > Roles > generating role > Revoke sessions > Revoke active sessions; or deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken on the principal

offboard.ui: Revoke the generating session: IAM console > Roles > role > Revoke sessions > Revoke active sessions

token_format.notes: Prefix not documented on fetched pages.

log_sources.name: AWS CloudTrail event history
log_sources.notes: On by default; 90 days of management events per Region; free. Data events (e.g. S3 GetObject) not included.

anomaly_cues: Bedrock calls from a principal that normally does not use Bedrock

containment.steps: Invalidate the generating session (revoke role sessions) or deny bedrock:CallWithBearerToken.
containment.notes: Short-term keys expire with the session (max 12 h).

calls.log_notes: Logged as management event; key value not logged.

unknown: No whoami call documented for Bedrock API keys.

detections.title: AWS Bedrock API Key Used for Destructive or Anti-Recovery Action
detections.detects: Bedrock API calls made with a bearer API key (callWithBearerToken=true) that delete guardrails, models, or logging configuration.
